verse: Forasmuch as ye know that you were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, ... but with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot. 1 Peter 1:18, 19.
title: The Blood That Redeems and Transforms
bullets: Christ's precious blood is the grand central truth that connects all of salvation's work, and without genuine faith in Him, knowledge alone is worthless.
True religion means sharing in Christ's sufferings and surrendering our whole heart to God, not merely maintaining cold, formal outward practices.
God calls us to zealous, living faith rather than lukewarm indifference, offering us spiritual riches when we serve Him faithfully with genuine devotion.

hymn.title: When I Survey the Wondrous Cross

prayer: Lord, help me never settle for a cold, formal faith that merely goes through the motions. Give me a heart burning with genuine love for You and filled with the precious reality of Christ's blood shed for my redemption, so that I might truly become rich in spiritual treasures.
